_comment: Phase 2 placeholder items: loot and future consumables. Full itemization (600+ items, equipment) is Phase 5. value is in copper.

items.name: Rat Whisker
items.description: A stiff, singed whisker. Some alchemist might want it.

items.name: Cracked Carapace
items.description: A piece of beetle shell, still warm.

items.name: Tattered Pelt
items.description: A scruffy hide, good for little.

items.name: Adder Fang
items.description: A hollow fang that still drips a little venom.

items.name: Bone Chips
items.description: Splinters of old bone.

items.name: Brigand Badge
items.description: A crude tin badge worn by road brigands.

items.name: Thornback Tusk
items.description: A curved tusk ridged with spines.

items.name: Ash Wolf Fang
items.description: A grey fang dusted with soot.

items.name: Silkfang Silk
items.description: A strong, sticky strand.

items.name: Mossy Heartstone
items.description: A green stone that pulses faintly.

items.name: Ember Shard
items.description: A sliver of crystal that never cools.

items.name: Ogre Molar
items.description: Huge, yellow, and unpleasant.

items.name: Tarnished Crest
items.description: The badge of a knightly order nobody remembers.

items.name: Storm Feather
items.description: It crackles when you touch it.

items.name: Bog Ichor
items.description: Foul black sludge in a stoppered vial.

items.name: Ironbark Chunk
items.description: Wood as hard as steel.

items.name: Ashen Sigil
items.description: A charred token bearing a spiral mark.

items.name: Basalt Drake Scale
items.description: A dark scale that holds heat for hours.

items.name: Frozen Essence
items.description: A shard of cold that never melts.

items.name: Crag Troll Hide
items.description: Thick, warty, and still twitching.

items.name: Obsidian Core
items.description: The glassy heart of a sentinel.

items.name: Cracked Phylactery
items.description: Something whispers inside.

items.name: Emberwyrm Scale
items.description: Red-gold and too hot to hold for long.

items.name: Grimjaw's Broken Tooth
items.description: A trophy from the oldest beast on the Flats.

items.name: Trail Rations
items.description: Dry bread and smoked meat. Eating arrives in a later update.

items.name: Minor Healing Draught
items.description: A small red potion. Drinking arrives in a later update.
